final: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) oa FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a FROM t, o WHERE t.a > o.oa), s AS (SELECT AVG(a) sa FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a FROM k1, s WHERE k1.a > s.sa) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k2.a - o.oa) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k2.a - s.sa) AS mean_above_second FROM k2, o, s
